title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression checks and CI gating
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: We need guardrails to catch prompt-set regressions and quality drops early in CI so model rollouts and infra changes do not cause silent degradations. This PR introduces a per-prompt regression check harness, CI gating job, and integration hooks for eval metrics so teams can block merges on significant quality regressions. Summary of changes: 1) add eval-harness/prompt_checks.py implementing per-prompt scoring, bootstrap confidence intervals and regression detector; 2) add .github/workflows/eval-regression-ci.yml which runs checks on changed prompt-sets and model snapshots; 3) integrate metrics export hooks to observability-pack for recording baseline and run metrics; 4) add tests and sample prompt-sets under eval-harness/tests/prompt_sets and update docs in redwood-docs/eval.md; 5) add an allowlist config for noisy prompts and a configurable threshold file at eval-harness/config/regression_thresholds.toml. Checklist: - [x] core detector implementation - [x] CI workflow and caching - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] docs and runbook - [x] Linear ticket linked Testing notes: local unit tests added for detector edge cases, CI runs include e2e evaluation against a small model snapshot and synthetic regressions; initial CI run failed on flaky prompt ordering test which was fixed by normalizing inputs. Rollout plan: enable as optional flag on main for two weeks, monitor alerts from metrics and adjust thresholds, then flip to required gating for release branches. Related: Linear ENG-1245, ENG-2031.
